title: 30A Beach House Seagrove Escape Panhandle Getaways
meta_description: 30A pet friendly beach house rental with private pool, Seagrove Escape, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly.
description_expanded: Description Description 30A pet friendly beach house rental with private pool, Seagrove Escape, located in Seagrove Beach, FL by Panhandle Getaways is a 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom vacation home complete with all of the conveniences of home. Pet Friendly. Traveling with a pet? Upon arrival, your pup will receive a Posh Pet Gift Pack filled with fun, beach-ready goodies. Each pack also includes a Posh Pet Photo Contest card with a QR code for easy uploads - simply share a photo of your furry friend enjoying their new gear and bandana. If your pet is featured on our website or social channels, you’ll receive special swag or exclusive discounts. Sunshine, sand, and tail-wagging adventures await! Free Activities Included. see details below*** FEATURES* 30A Beach House - Pet Friendly* Spacious Backyard with Pool* Fenced Backyard - Perfect for Your Furry Friends* Covered Patio with Seating* Spacious Living Area with 46" TV and View of Private Pool* Large Kitchen w/Breakfast Bar* Dining Area* Bedroom 1 - King Bed, Office Area, En Suite Bathroom (Walk In Shower)* Bedroom 2 - Queen Bed, 1st Floor* Bedroom 3 - Queen Bed, 2nd Floor* Bathroom 4 - Bunk Bed (Twin over Full), 2nd Floor* Loft Bedroom - Queen Bed, TV - Loft Bedroom, Only Accessible through Primary Bedroom* 2 Additional Bathrooms with Tub/Shower Combo* Washer / Dryer* Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi* Sleeps 11 Pool may be heated for an additional fee of $50.00 per day. TV is Streaming Services Only 30A Public Beach Access Points Surveillance Device: Ring Doorbell at Front Door Bonus***Guests receive 1 free daily admission to some of our favorite local attractions through our partnership with Xplorie. All perks are valid for stays up to 27 days and are subject to change and availability. BONUS PERKS INCLUDED WITH YOUR STAY: * 1 FREE Round of Golf at 1 of 4 Golf Courses in the area Every Day - Year Round* 4 Bikes - Ready to Go at the Home - Year Round* 1 FREE Voucher to use for an unforgettable Dolphin Cruise and/or Snorkel trip Each Day! (Mar-Oct) PET FRIENDLYPets are only allowed in rental properties marked pet friendly. Pets must be disclosed at time of booking. A non-refundable pet fee is charged for anyone bringing a pet. A pet or any evidence of a pet found on the property that was not previously disclosed by the guest is cause for eviction with forfeiture of moneys paid plus additional cleaning charges of up to $500. This is strictly enforced. DOGS ONLY - Maximum of 2 dogs, unless previously authorized. INITIAL SUPPLIES - UPON ARRIVALPanhandle Getaways furnishes a few essential items for guests to utilize until they can get to the grocery store. Initial Supplies include: Dishwasher soap, small washing machine powder, each bathroom has amenities (like hotel but NOT restocked) shampoo, conditioner, soap bar. One roll of toilet paper in each bathroom and one paper towel roll in the kitchen. All bed linens and towels are provided. We encourage guests to bring beach towels for use at the pool and beach. Read more

Extras, Services & Complimentary Items: 1 Complimentary Round of Golf Each Day (March - Oct)
Pool / Spa / Hot Tub: Private Pool - Heated for an Additional Fee
